         signatures  NOT verified, and nothing was weakened: this host has no
                     policy.json where podman looks, so there was no posture
                     to preserve. A stock podman here accepts any image too
── the host's own accepts anything
         signatures  NOT verified, because your host does not verify them
                     either: /home/u/.config/containers/policy.json accepts
                     any image, and snug reproduces it rather than deciding
── the host's own demands a signature
         signatures  as /etc/containers/policy.json requires.
                     snug projects that file into the engine's own
                     policy.json — the keys it names are copies snug makes,
                     because a host path resolves to nothing in the engine's
                     derived view. A requirement snug cannot reproduce
                     refuses the run rather than being dropped
── the host's own cannot be reproduced
         signatures  THIS RUN WILL REFUSE. The engine's policy.json is a
                     projection of your host's, and this host configured one
                     snug cannot reproduce. Accepting any image instead would
                     drop exactly the check you configured:
                     /etc/containers/policy.json: transport "docker", scope "registry.example.internal" is "sigstoreSigned", which snug does not project.
                     Fix: use a signedBy requirement for the scopes a sandbox needs.
